svg.title: find_anomalies on a Spark DataFrame of events
svg.desc: A data scientist calls find_anomalies on a Spark DataFrame of payment events, grouped by segment with each segment scored against its own accounts, shows the three entities furthest from their segment, then calls explain on the top one, A000335. On the right, the retail segment in delta space: a sample of 70 of its 697 entities plus the two retail entities of the top three; the θ ring draws in and the flagged entities light up (the flag comes from the calibrated score, so an entity can sit beyond θ unflagged), and the line to A000335 is labelled with its largest deviation, burst_max_daily. Distance from the centroid is real (sqrt of delta_norm / theta_norm); angles are illustrative. Synthetic data; an outlier is unusual, not proof of wrongdoing.
svg.text: One call: events in Spark, scored entities out.
